# Ghost (`tryghost-ghost`)

Experience the power of Ghost, the leading open-source Node.js CMS! With Ghost(Pro), launch a secure, high-performance site in 2 minutes, featuring worldwide CDN, backups, and maintenance.

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Ghost.html) · [Source](https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "tryghost-ghost"
  name       = "myghost"

  parameters = {
    DatabaseUrl = "..."
    # SmtpHost    = "..."
    # SmtpPort    = "..."
    # SmtpUser    = "..."
    # MailFrom    = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    SmtpPass = var.smtp_pass
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DatabaseUrl` | string | yes | Database connection string for Ghost's primary data storage. Ghost requires a database to store all content, users, settings, and metadata. |
| `SmtpHost` | string | no | SMTP server hostname for sending emails. Ghost uses this to send member notifications, password resets, and newsletter emails. |
| `SmtpPort` | string | no | SMTP server port number for email delivery. Common ports are 587 (TLS) or 465 (SSL) for secure email transmission. |
| `SmtpUser` | string | no | Username for SMTP server authentication. Required when the email provider needs authentication credentials for sending emails. |
| `SmtpPass` | string | no | Password for SMTP server authentication. Used alongside SMTP_USER to authenticate with the email provider for sending emails. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `MailFrom` | string | no | Default 'from' email address for all emails sent by Ghost. This appears as the sender address for newsletters, notifications, and system emails. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
